chapter.heading: Obedience Better than Fasting
chapter.v:
Now in
the fourth year of King Darius it came to pass that the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, on the fourth day of the ninth month, Chislev, [2 Cor. 5:12;] [Acts 18:27]

when the
people sent Sherezer, with Regem-Melech and his men, to the house of God, to pray before the Lord, [2 Cor. 5:11]

and to
ask the priests who were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month and fast as I have done for so many years?” [[1 Cor. 1:18]; 2 Cor. 2:15]

Then the
word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying, [John 12:31; [Eph. 6:12] f John 12:40 g [2 Cor. 3:8, 9] h [John 1:18]; Phil. 2:6; Col. 1:15; Heb. 1:3]

“Say to
all the people of the land, and to the priests: ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months during those seventy years, did you really fast for Me—for Me? [[John 15:5] h 1 Cor. 15:10] [1 Cor. 1:13 j 1 Cor. 9:19]

When you
eat and when you drink, do you not eat and drink for yourselves? [1 Cor. 3:5; Eph. 3:7 j Jer. 31:31; Matt. 26:28; Luke 22:20 k Rom. 2:27 l [Rom. 3:20]; Gal. 3:10 m John 6:63; Rom. 8:2] [Gen. 1:3 l Is. 9:2; Mal. 4:2; Luke 1:78; 2 Pet. 1:19]

Should you
not have obeyed the words which the Lord proclaimed through the former prophets when Jerusalem and the cities around it were inhabited and prosperous, and the South and the Lowland were inhabited?’ ”Disobedience Resulted in Captivity [Rom. 7:10 o Ex. 34:1; Deut. 10:1] [Judg. 7:2; 1 Cor. 2:5] [Ex. 34:29]

Then the
word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying, [2 Cor. 1:8; 7:5] [[Gal. 3:5]]

“Thus says
the Lord of hosts:‘Execute true justice,Show mercy and compassionEveryone to his brother. [[Rom. 1:17;] [Ps. 129:2; [Heb. 13:5] p Ps. 37:24]

Do not
oppress the widow or the fatherless,The alien or the poor.Let none of you plan evil in his heartAgainst his brother.’ [Rom. 8:17] [Phil. 3:10]

“But they
refused to heed, shrugged their shoulders, and stopped their ears so that they could not hear. [Rom. 8:36]

Yes, they
made their hearts like flint, refusing to hear the law and the words which the Lord of hosts had sent by His Spirit through the former prophets. Thus great wrath came from the Lord of hosts. [Acts 4:13, 29; 2 Cor. 7:4; Eph.]

Therefore it
happened, that just as He proclaimed and they would not hear, so they called out and I would not listen,” says the Lord of hosts. [2 Pet. 1:1 u Ps.]

“But I
scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they had not known. Thus the land became desolate after them, so that no one passed through or returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.” [[Rom. 8:11]]
